A farm faking 192 aliases needs 192 separate result archives, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The dawn test is the price tag: 192 fakes mean 192 payments. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The shale signal is visible to every grader, and the cipher ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
